title: Unlawful gifts by lobbyists.
bodyText:
(a) It shall be unlawful for a lobbyist or any person or entity required to file a statement of expenditures under section 97-3 to make a gift to a legislator or employee that is prohibited by section 84-11 or title 21, chapter 7 of the Hawaii administrative rules.

(b) For the purposes of this section, "employee" shall have the same meaning as defined in section 84-3.
bodyHtml:
[§97-5.5]  Unlawful gifts by lobbyists.  (a)  It shall be unlawful for a lobbyist or any person or entity required to file a statement of expenditures under section 97-3 to make a gift to a legislator or employee that is prohibited by section 84-11 or title 21, chapter 7 of the Hawaii administrative rules.

     (b)  For the purposes of this section, "employee" shall have the same meaning as defined in section 84-3. [L 2023, c 10, §2]
